examples.label: Order tracking from payment to doorstep
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-timeline" site="Global" id="timeline-order-tracking" color="success" hide_last_line>
  <.component component_name="chelekom-timeline-section" site="Global" bullet_icon="hero-check" size="medium" title="Payment confirmed" time="12 March, 09:14" description="Your card was charged $184.00 and a receipt is on its way to your inbox." />
  <.component component_name="chelekom-timeline-section" site="Global" bullet_icon="hero-archive-box" size="medium" title="Packed in Bristol" time="12 March, 16:02" description="Two items were packed into a single box and handed to the evening collection." />
  <.component component_name="chelekom-timeline-section" site="Global" bullet_icon="hero-truck" size="medium" title="Out for delivery" time="13 March, 07:45" description="The driver has 14 stops before yours. We will text you two stops ahead." />
  <.component component_name="chelekom-timeline-section" site="Global" bullet_icon="hero-home" size="medium" title="Delivered" time="13 March, 11:28" description="Left in the porch as requested and photographed for your records." />
</.component>

examples.label: Company milestones for an about page
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-timeline" site="Global" id="timeline-company-milestones" color="primary" hide_last_line>
  <.component component_name="chelekom-timeline-section" site="Global" line_style="dashed" size="small" title="Two people and a shared repository" time="2019" description="We started as a consultancy building Phoenix applications for other teams, and kept rewriting the same components on every project." />
  <.component component_name="chelekom-timeline-section" site="Global" line_style="dashed" size="small" title="The first open-source release" time="2021" description="Those components became a public kit. Within a year it was installed in production by more than four hundred teams." />
  <.component component_name="chelekom-timeline-section" site="Global" line_style="dashed" size="small" title="A content system around the kit" time="2023" description="Editors asked to change pages without a deploy, so we built the page builder that now sits at the centre of the product." />
  <.component component_name="chelekom-timeline-section" site="Global" line_style="dashed" size="small" title="Twelve people, still no sales team" time="2025" description="Everything we ship is used first by the people who build it, and that has not changed since the second commit." />
</.component>

examples.label: Horizontal release timeline across four quarters
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-timeline" site="Global" id="timeline-release-horizontal" horizontal color="info">
  <.component component_name="chelekom-timeline-section" site="Global" horizontal bullet_icon="hero-rocket-launch" size="medium" title="1.0 shipped" time="Q1" description="The first stable release, with sixty components and a documented upgrade path." />
  <.component component_name="chelekom-timeline-section" site="Global" horizontal bullet_icon="hero-sparkles" size="medium" title="Theme builder" time="Q2" description="Colour and radius tokens became editable in the browser instead of in a config file." />
  <.component component_name="chelekom-timeline-section" site="Global" horizontal bullet_icon="hero-squares-2x2" size="medium" title="Page builder" time="Q3" description="Drag-and-drop editing arrived, with drafts and a live preview for every page." />
  <.component component_name="chelekom-timeline-section" site="Global" horizontal bullet_icon="hero-globe-alt" size="medium" title="Multi-site" time="Q4" description="One installation now serves several sites, each with its own theme and editors." />
</.component>
